summary: ICF International filed an 8-K announcing Q2 2026 results and a quarterly dividend of $0.14 per share, paid October 9, 2026, to holders of record September 4, 2026. The filing also notes 435,055 shares repurchased in H1 2026 and reaffirms guidance. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration, not a special situation. No merger, tender, spin-off, or strategic event is involved. The dividend is ordinary and discretionary; repurchases are part of ongoing capital return. The filing is informational only, with no deal terms or unusual corporate actions.
